clips.send: In the Spring and Autumn period the Zhou king grew weak and the lords fought to be “hegemon”. Duke Huan of Qi employed Guan Zhong to reform, rallied the lords with “honour the king, drive off the barbarians”, and became the first hegemon. Jin, Chu, Wu and Yue later competed too.

clips.send: What happens when a king is too weak to control his own lords? In China it meant 550 years of rivalry and war (770–221 BCE) — and the greatest burst of new ideas in Chinese history. Confucius lived in this age, at about the same time as the Buddha in India and just before Socrates in Greece.
